rules.statement: In a lease of a chose in action, the requirement as to delivery of possession is fulfilled by the execution of the assignment; however, the lessee is also entitled to 'quiet enjoyment' and can recover damages if prevented from enjoying the leased property.
rules.supporting_quote: "For quiet enjoyment of the thing let, both on the part of the lessor and others. The actio conducti lies when the lessee is not permitted to enjoy the thing leased."
